title: A novel neural network with predefined-time stability for solving generalized monotone inclusion problems with applications
summary: We propose a novel dynamical framework for solving inclusion problems of the form \(0 \in F(x) + G(x)\) in Hilbert spaces, where \(F\) is a maximal set-valued operator and \(G\) is a single-valued mapping. The analysis is conducted under a generalized monotonicity assumption, which relaxes the classical monotonicity conditions commonly imposed in the literature and thereby extends the applicability of the proposed approach.
